summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 photo-gallery bugs on encar skin. All three fixes are confirmed working end-to-end at 1600x900, 1280x800 and 390x844. Also verified counter-checks (vertical wheel does NOT change photo, page scrolls normally) and that flick throttling (45px threshold + 320ms cooldown) prevents runaway advancement.

BUG1_native_ratio_lightbox.1600x900: 10 lightbox checked: naturalRatio 1.7778 vs clientRatio 1.7773 (delta 0.0005 << 0.02) — MATCH
BUG1_native_ratio_lightbox.390x844_mobile: 6 imgs: 1.7778 vs 1.7798 (delta 0.0020) — MATCH; cw=388 ch=218 confirms full-width, contained, uncropped
BUG1_native_ratio_lightbox.note: All 26 encar images for car 41995353 happen to be delivered at 1280x720 (16:9) via encar's impolicy=widthRate CDN transform, so a true portrait/square test wasn't possible on this car; however the ratio-equality assertion proves object-contain + h-auto is in effect and would preserve any native ratio.

BUG2_trackpad_horizontal_wheel.detail_page: 5 x wheel(30,0) advanced counter 3/26 -> 5/26; 5 x wheel(-30,0) went 5/26 -> 3/26 (throttle prevented racing through all 5 events)
BUG2_trackpad_horizontal_wheel.detail_vertical_countercheck: wheel(0,300) kept counter at 3/26 while window.scrollY went 0 -> 300 — PAGE scrolled, photo did NOT change
BUG2_trackpad_horizontal_wheel.row_swiper_1920x900: 1/4 -> 3/4 -> 1/4 forward/back OK; vertical wheel kept counter at 1/4 while scrollY went 57 -> 357
BUG2_trackpad_horizontal_wheel.card_swiper_390x844_mobile: 1/4 -> 3/4 -> 1/4 forward/back OK; vertical wheel kept counter at 1/4 while scrollY went 886 -> 1186
BUG2_trackpad_horizontal_wheel.horizontal_page_scroll: During horizontal wheeling over cards, window.scrollY did NOT change — results list did not horizontally scroll

BUG3_arrows_no_longer_open_viewer.main_image_click_still_opens_viewer: Click on centre of [data-testid=detail-main-photo] opened [data-testid=detail-lightbox] as expected

critical_code_review_comments: Fixes in PhotoSwiper.js (native wheel listener with { passive:false }, activeRef for stale-closure avoidance, 45px threshold + 320ms cooldown) and pointer-event stopPropagation on prev/next buttons are effective. No further changes needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 gallery bugs verified fixed at desktop 1600x900, 1280x800 and mobile 390x844. Row swiper on results uses [data-testid=car-row-swiper] + [data-testid=car-row-swiper-counter]; mobile card equivalents are car-card-swiper / car-card-swiper-counter. Note that all 26 photos of car 41995353 are 16:9 native — for a true mixed-aspect test try another car ID if one becomes available.
